vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Cameron, Wyatt, Ritwik, Nadia and Valeria met them at the door — 5 put down. Cameron, Wyatt, Ritwik, Nadia, Valeria are hurt.
🛡️ Cameron, Nadia, Tashi and Victor met them at the door — 4 put down. Cameron, Nadia, Tashi, Victor are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Cameron — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Cameron chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Cameron, Wyatt, Ruby and Ritwik met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Cameron, Wyatt, Ruby, Ritwik are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Owen just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cameron just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Cameron, Aria and Tashi met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Cameron, Aria are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Tashi sees The Eulogy and gives it room — not ready alone, going back for help.
Tashi sees The Eulogy and gives it room — not ready alone, going back for help.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Cameron Khanna, 56 — an electrician. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Echo Location, Fusion Reactor.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Valeria showed Boris the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Boris met them at the door — 1 put down. Boris is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
